changelog:
- Initial release of the linkedin-lead-gen skill.
- Provides a structured workflow to identify, research, and verify non-tech founders on LinkedIn as high-value prospects.
- Generates professional HTML-based PDF reports summarizing qualified leads and technology service opportunities.
- Offers clear guidelines for targeting, strict filtering, research, gap analysis, and personalized outreach.
- Outlines recommended tools and visual standards for report generation.
summary: Search for, research, and verify non-tech founders on LinkedIn to identify high-value prospects for technology services (Web Dev, ERP, CRM, App Dev, SEO, AI)...
